svg.aria-label: Constitutional Agent Testbench. A deterministic contract checker for structured AI outputs: it evaluates a JSON response against a declared, machine-readable policy, and PrecedenceTrace checks whether permuting peer rules changes the result. Shown as four rule plates that swap places on one beam while the verdict ring below stays green.
